export_controls.text: We must also advance strict regulation as it pertains to the safety of kids, teens, and vulnerable populations, ensuring chatbots and other AI tools are built with safety top of mind. Export controls on the advanced AI chips are also critical to ensure that AI is developed in America, for the benefit of Americans.

deepseek.reason: The speaker calls export controls on advanced AI chips critical.
